fix_code:
def find_nth_good_integer(N: int) -> None:
    N -= 1

    goodint = []

    while N != 0 or not goodint:  # Corrected condition to handle N=0 case
        goodint.append((N % 5) * 2)
        N //= 5

    goodint = goodint[::-1]
    for digit in goodint:
        print(digit, end="")
